# OpenCADStudio - Release v2026.45 (2026-11-08)

> **Summary:** Rebuilt the Layer Manager with in-drawing layer filters and a shared selection-filter engine; overhauled tables with cell styles, in-place editing and fill grips; added the Quad cursor menu with a plugin quad surface; expanded dynamic block authoring with Flip parameters, ordered action follow-ups and a Parameters Manager; advanced HATCH island/boundary handling, annotative scale and complex linetypes; added `COMPARE`, `BURST`, `XBIND`, `PREVIEW`/`PUBLISH` and SVG import; and delivered broad performance work on TRIM, OSNAP/OTRACK, viewports and large drawings.

---

### 🌟 Notable Release Notes

* **Layer Manager and Filters:** Rebuilt the Layer Manager (filter tree beside the table, mockup rows and eyes, narrow pallet, columns, import from another drawing) with nested filters stored in the drawing, wildcard/property filters applied from the search, layer groups, `-LAYTRANS`, `-LAYERSTATE`/LAS and `XBIND`. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn), [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
* **Quick Select and FILTER:** Advanced selection filter with window, pattern help, states and live match count, saved filters in the drawing or a file, and `'FILTER`/`'QSELECT` inside a running command. *(Contributed by [@turbuczn](https://github.com/turbuczn))*
* **Tables Overhaul:** Table style cell styles with starting tables and insert-from-style; cell picking, grips, fill grips, a Table Cell ribbon tab, in-place editing, insert N rows/columns, break and fill; typed values checked against the cell's data type, with dates, currency/percent, thousands separators and two-digit year handling; wrapped text grows rows; `TABLECONTENT` kept in step. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@insanedps](https://github.com/insanedps))*
* **Quad Cursor Menu (API v15):** Entity-aware cursor menu with per-type panels and a plugin quad surface; plugin host hardened (NullHost document access, boot-ack observability, channel-ready dispatch). *(Contributed by [@schoeller](https://github.com/schoeller) and [@yztink](https://github.com/yztink))*
* **Dynamic Block Authoring:** Flip parameters end-to-end and their coupled caches migrated across edits; ordered action follow-ups with retained-branch evaluation; value sets for linear, XY, polar and rotation parameters; naming and label prompts at placement; lookup tables keep a blank next-value row; nested reference properties and visibility states edited in batches; the Parameters Manager edits rows and filters in place. *(Contributed by [@KarimJerbi](https://github.com/KarimJerbi), with Save Block crash recovery from [@Ch4rlos](https://github.com/Ch4rlos))*
* **HATCH and GRADIENT:** Command-line keywords, draw and path modes, shared arc options, a full Hatch panel, boundary path flags and forms, picked regions keep nested islands, island selection follows the circle start rule, Normal skips unflagged islands, ANGLE first in bundled patterns. *(Contributed by [@ramox81](https://github.com/ramox81) and [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao))*
* **Annotation Scale and Complex Linetypes:** Model-space linetypes honour `MSLTSCALE`; viewports honour `PSLTSCALE`; annotative attributes, dimensions and objects follow the current scale and the layout's own setting; a drawing opens at its saved scale; dashes keep their length in a scaled INSERT; multileader/dimension blocks, wide polylines and complex linetypes draw on block children; aligned linetypes fit every whole period per run. *(Contributed by [@silvioteston](https://github.com/silvioteston) and [@jespinolao](https://github.com/jespinolao))*
* **New Commands and Parity:** `COMPARE` (modified objects, settings and a CSV report), `BURST`, `XBIND`, `PREVIEW` (SVG), `PUBLISH`/`-PAGESETUP`/`EXPORTPDF`, `-LAYTRANS`/`-LAYERSTATE`, `-FIELD`, `SCALELISTEDIT`, `ANNOUPDATE`, `SELECT`/`SELECTPREVIOUS`, `LO

Open CAD Studio

Open-source 2D drafting and 3D modeling for desktop and web, built with Rust.

Launch the web app · Download the desktop app · Join the discussion

## Overview Open CAD Studio is a cross-platform application for technical drawing, layout work, and solid modeling. It reads and writes DWG and DXF drawings natively, with a shared editing core across the desktop and browser versions. The experimental **IFCCAD** format choice exchanges supported CAD drawings in `.ifccad` files. Existing `.ifcx` drawings remain readable. General IFCX BIM models are not supported by this drawing route. This alpha functionality is for testing only: later versions may not reopen these files, and backward compatibility or migration is not guaranteed. Keep original drawings and separate DWG/DXF copies. See the [IFCCAD workflow and compatibility guide](docs/ifccad.md). The project is under active development. Keep backups of important production drawings and report reproducible problems through [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/issues). ## Highlights - **Native drawing workflow** — open, edit, recover, and save DWG and DXF files without a conversion service. - **Precise 2D drafting** — lines, polylines, curves, splines, hatches, object snaps, tracking, layers, blocks, and external references. - **Documentation tools** — text, dimensions, leaders, tolerances, tables, model space, paper space, viewports, and plot styles. - **Kernel-backed 3D modeling** — solid primitives, extrusion, revolution, sweep, loft, Boolean operations, and ACIS entity tessellation. - **GPU rendering** — accelerated 2D and 3D viewports through `wgpu`, with orthographic and perspective cameras. - **Extensible workflows** — native plugins, command scripts, headless conversion, and a line-based JSON automation API.

## File workflows | Format or workflow | Support | | --- | --- | | DWG | Read and write; versioned save targets from R14 through 2018 | | DXF | Read and write; versioned save targets from R14 through 2018 | | BAK / SV$ | Open drawing backups and autosave files | | OBJ | Import polygon meshes | | SVG / SVGZ | Import vector shapes as a block (`SVGIN`, or `IMPORT`) | | LandXML | Import `CgPoint` survey points | | STL | Export 3D mesh data | | STEP AP203 | Export 3D mesh data | | PDF | Plot layouts and selected geometry on desktop | | CSV | Extract entity property data | | CTB / STB | Load and edit plot style tables | ## Desktop or web Use the [web app](https://www.opencadstudio.com) for immediate access with no installation. Drawings are selected through the browser and saved as local downloads. Use the desktop application for native file associations, file-manager thumbnails, system printing, PDF output, external plugins, command scripts, and headless automation. Release builds are available for Windows, Linux, and Apple Silicon macOS. ## Install Download the package for your computer from the [download page](https://www.opencadstudio.com/download/); every link there is the latest release. All files are also on the [latest release](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/releases/latest) page. ### Windows Choose one of these signed packages, `x86_64` for Intel and AMD processors or `arm64` for ARM processors: - `OpenCADStudio-*-windows-x86_64-installer.msi` / `…-windows-arm64-installer.msi` — recommended installer with Start Menu shortcuts, DWG/DXF file associations, and drawing thumbnails. - `OpenCADStudio-*-windows-x86_64-portable.exe` / `…-windows-arm64-portable.exe` — standalone application; no installation required. Or install via Windows Package Manager: ```powershell winget install HakanSeven.OpenCADStudio ``` ### Linux Download the AppImage (`linux-x86_64` or `linux-aarch64` for ARM), make it executable, and run it: ```bash chmod +x OpenCADStudio-*-linux-x86_64.AppImage ./OpenCADStudio-*-linux-x86_64.AppImage ``` Or install it as a Flatpak from [FlatPark](https://flatpark.org/apps/io.github.HakanSeven12.OpenCadStudio), which installs the official AppImage and follows new releases: ```bash flatpak remote-add --if-not-exists flatpark https://dl.flatpark.org/flatpark.flatpakrepo flatpak install flatpark io.github.HakanSeven12.OpenCadStudio ``` The Flatpak opens and saves drawings through the file chooser. External references and underlays that point at other files need home access: ```bash flatpak override --user --filesystem=home io.github.HakanSeven12.OpenCadStudio ``` Each release also carries a snap. It is not in the Snap Store yet, so snapd installs it only with `--dangerous`, and it does not update itself: ```bash sudo snap install --dangerous OpenCADStudio-*-linux-x86_64.snap ``` ### macOS Packages are published for Apple Silicon and Intel Macs: 1. Download `OpenCADStudio-*-macos-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `OpenCADStudio-*-macos-x86_64.dmg` (Intel). 2. Open the image and drag `OpenCADStudio.app` into **Applications**. 3. If Gatekeeper blocks the first launch, approve the app from **System Settings → Privacy & Security**. The application is ad-hoc signed but is not currently notarized by Apple. ## Languages Open CAD Studio can follow the system language or use any of these 23 interface languages: > Arabic · Brazilian Portuguese · Bulgarian · Czech · Dutch · English · Finnish · French · German · Greek · Hindi · Hungarian · Italian · Japanese · Korean · Lao · Polish · Russian · Simplified Chinese · Spanish · Traditional Chinese · Turkish · Vietnamese Change the language from the application settings. The browser version also uses the browser's preferred locale when **System** is selected. ## Build from source ### Desktop Requirements: - Git - Current stable Rust toolchain - Platform graphics and font development libraries On Ubuntu or Debian, install the native dependencies with: ```bash sudo apt update sudo apt install libgl1-mesa-dev libx11-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev \ libxrandr-dev libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev libfontconfig1-dev \ libfreetype6-dev ``` Then build and run: ```bash git clone https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio.git cd OpenCADStudio cargo build --release --bin OpenCADStudio ``` The resulting binary is written to `target/release/OpenCADStudio` (`OpenCADStudio.exe` on Windows). ### Web Install the WebAssembly target and build tools once: ```bash rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown cargo install trunk wasm-bindgen-cli ``` Start the development server: ```bash trunk serve ``` ## Automation The desktop binary supports one-shot conversion, a persistent headless server, and a client-neutral MCP endpoint for AI applications: ```bash OpenCADStudio --export input.dwg output.dxf OpenCADStudio --export input-r12.dxf output.dwg --target-version R14 OpenCADStudio --serve OpenCADStudio --serve --port 4242 OpenCADStudio --mcp ``` The automation server exchanges one JSON object per line over standard input/output or a local TCP socket. The self-contained MCP endpoint exposes the live desktop editor through the same tools to every compatible client. Its `audit` and `save_verified` operations check an explicit DWG/DXF target version, lossy records, raw DXF handle references, reopen the output, compare its semantic manifest, and return a SHA-256 hash. To connect a client, configure it to launch `OpenCADStudio --mcp`. See the [MCP control guide](docs/automation/README.md). ## Plugins Desktop plugins run in separate processes and communicate with the host through the versioned plugin API. The browser build does not load native plugins. - [Plugin architecture](docs/plugin-architecture.md) - [Plugin template](docs/plugin-template/README.md) - [Plugin registry](plugins/README.md) ## Project documentation - [Automation API](docs/automation/README.md) - [Plugin architecture](docs/plugin-architecture.md) - [Tessellation pipeline](docs/tessellation.md) - [Security policy](SECURITY.md) ## Contributing Bug reports, focused pull requests, translations, documentation improvements, and plugin contributions are welcome. - Search existing [issues](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/issues) before opening a new report. - Use [Discussions](https://github.com/HakanSeven12/OpenCADStudio/discussions) for questions and ideas. - Report vulnerabilities privately by following the [security policy](SECURITY.md). Application translations live in `locales/*/opencadstudio.ftl`; source labels map through `src/locale_catalog.rs`. After editing translations, run `python3 scripts/export-locales.py` to refresh web and desktop packaging labels. Validate with `python3 scripts/test_site.py` and `cargo test --lib i18n::tests`. ## Project growth ### Stars ### Release downloads ## Support the project If Open CAD Studio helps your work, support continued development through [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/HakanSeven12) or [Patreon](https://www.patreon.com/HakanSeven12). ## License Open CAD Studio is distributed under the [GNU General Public License v3.0](LICENSE).
